impact: Nvidia's guide is the biggest swing factor of the week for MU, DRAM, SNXX and NBIS (options price NVDA about ±8.6%); a strong Anthropic debut would support GOOGL, MSFT and MU, which are among its anchor buyers.
summary: Nvidia reports fiscal Q3 after the close on Tuesday, Nov. 17, with analysts expecting EPS of $2.47 on revenue of $108.8 billion, its first report under interim CEO Colette Kress. October retail sales are due Tuesday, Walmart reports Thursday (about $0.63 EPS on $187.2B revenue expected), and Home Depot, Target, Lowe's and Fed minutes are also on the calendar. Anthropic is expected to price its IPO at $70 to $78 on Nov. 18 and start trading as ANT on Nov. 19.
title: Week ahead: Nvidia earnings Tue ($108.8B expected), retail sales, Walmart, Anthropic IPO
